The lever: instrument the checkout and fix it. Don't touch the ad spend — pouring more traffic in just feeds a leakier bucket. Caveat: confirm the gap is genuine drop-off and not legit COD/abandonment that later converts via your recovery flow — pull the actual checkout-abandonment reasons before you assume it's all pure friction.
